enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Move arm. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Adjust blanket. Lie still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands together. Rinse face with water. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bread. Close cupboard. Place bread on counter. Pick up frying pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Put eggs on plate. Pick up fork. Eat breakfast.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates from table. Pick up utensils. Stack plates. Carry plates to sink. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Place plates in dishwasher. Place utensils in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and checking phone messages and calendar
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Pick up phone. Press power button. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Open calendar app. Check schedule. Put down phone. Pick up socks. Put on socks. Pick up shoes. Put on shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Light stretching and watching morning news on TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel to news. Sit on floor. Stretch arms. Stretch legs. Bend forward. Stand up. Twist torso. Sit on sofa. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change volume. Put down remote.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on computer, coordinating community program logistics
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Pick up phone. Make call. Talk on phone. Hang up. Type on computer. Open document. Write notes. Save document. Close computer. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out lettuce, tomato, cheese. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bread. Close cupboard. Place bread on cutting board. Pick up knife. Cut bread. Cut lettuce. Cut tomato. Pick up plate. Assemble sandwich. Pick up sandwich. Eat lunch. Drink water. Pick up plate. Put plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Lunch break, resting on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Lean back. Put feet up. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Close eyes. Adjust pillow. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on computer, drafting program reports and emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open word processor. Draft report. Type paragraphs. Save document. Open email. Compose email. Attach file. Send email. Open spreadsheet. Update data. Save spreadsheet. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Continue typing. Print document. Pick up document. Read document.

enriched_activities.activity: Making tea and taking a short break
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on stove. Turn on stove. Wait for water to boil. Turn off stove. Pour water into mug. Add tea bag. Stir tea. Pick up mug. Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on computer, finishing tasks and returning calls
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open computer. Open task list. Complete tasks. Pick up phone. Dial number. Talk on phone. Hang up. Pick up phone again. Dial another number. Talk. Hang up. Type on computer. Save work. Close computer. Stand up. Stretch.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down after work, relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Lean back. Put feet up. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up magazine. Flip pages. Put down magazine. Close eyes. Adjust pillow. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Stir. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Put food on plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut food. Eat food. Drink water. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Continue eating. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Put plate in sink. Pick up glass. Put glass in sink. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Lean back. Put feet up. Adjust pillow. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Close door. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Wait for water to heat. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Rub soap on body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply shampoo to hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and playing games on the game console
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up game controller. Turn on TV. Turn on game console. Select game. Play game. Press buttons. Move controller. Pause game. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Resume game. Play game. Turn off game console. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down for the night
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Put down book. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Turn off light. Lie down. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Nighttime washing and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Wash hands. Rinse hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Move arm. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Adjust blanket. Lie still.
